final: SELECT AVG(customer_total), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM (SELECT customer_total, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM (SELECT customer_total, customer_total / overall_sum AS share FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) AS customer_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(customer_total) AS overall_sum FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) AS overall WHERE overall_sum IS NOT NULL) WHERE share > average_share) AS kept
